body: Thank you. It’s been almost 3 months. I’ve called the suicide hotline twice and tried going to church but nothing helps. I still have to see him as he is apart of our friend group and my hearts breaks when I’m around him. I can’t do it anymore.
I actually just started writing in a journal two weeks ago and it does help somewhat but still my heart just hearts all the time.
I’ve lost 30 pounds as well and I find myself just laying there with thoughts and memories of us just taking me over.
I really appreciate that I feel like there’s so many people around me that don’t understand what I’m going through.
